records.title: Urgent shipping space for personnel and horses
records.header_literal: B) KOW v RVA (01.36 a.m., November 26th); KR AN LP 2100 (11/25) 3 TLE; (1 TL missing); 2 TL RICHI-188
records.readable_german: Sofortige Sendung von Schiffsraum fuer J3YYY Mann 3YYY Pferde. J3YYY Mann 3YYY Pferde. RTVL dringend geboten.
records.meaning: The surviving second part urgently requests shipping capacity for personnel and horses. The paired capacity labels are repeated in the source. J3YYY, 3YYY and RTVL remain literal; no numerical total or port identification is imposed.
notes: The source explicitly says “1 TL missing.” This edition starts with the complete native 188-coordinate second part and supplies no missing first body.
SEGDUNG to SENDUNG is one observed-coordinate substitution. All source coordinates remain in native order.
Both repetitions of J3YYY MANN 3YYY PFERDE remain in the exact stream and readable passage. They are not silently converted to familiar decimal numbers or counted as separate telegrams.
RTVL is not expanded into a named port or headquarters. The printed interception date November 26 and originating line 11/25 remain separate.

records.title: Probable reliance on sea transport; literal command references
records.header_literal: B) KOW v RVA (01.36 a.m., November 26th); KR AN LP 2100 (11/25) 3 TLE; 3 TL RICHI-200
records.readable_german: Da wahrscheinlich alle Truppen auf Seetransport angewiesen. Gen. Kdo. ? B V 72. Gen. Kdo. Z B N 72. JAXNR42XJ2GEH.
records.meaning: The third part explains that all troops will probably depend on sea transport. Its command and reference fields remain literal. This is a stated expectation and an urgent request for capacity, not proof that ships were supplied or the troops transported.
notes: The native 200-coordinate body contains one printed dash in -AGXG. It remains masked and unfilled; no observed coordinate changes.
The remaining source-mask position has domain {3, D, F, M, T, X}. A familiar abbreviation is not forced into that field.
The two command fields retain their different V and N labels, the repeated 72, and the complete footer JAXNR42XJ2GEH. No historical unit identity or numbered reference is inferred.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
